purpose: Sign-specific two-part Calendar cards composed from the owner-approved meaning components. Each card carries a forecast the reader can use and a Details explanation underneath.
servingRule: Both ownerApproved and servingAuthorized must be true. Anything else is invisible to the runtime and the Calendar falls through to the existing exact body for that planet pair and aspect.
storedBodyConvention: forecast begins lowercase; the Calendar composes the date lead-in. details begins with the transit label, for example 'Sun in Leo opposite Saturn in Aquarius.'

cards.forecast: a cause people care about may gain enough support to put pressure on a rule or system that is no longer working. Neptune in Aries sextile Pluto in Aquarius can turn shared conviction into enough momentum to move something that has been stuck. The risk is mistaking attention for progress. Name the change you want, then put your energy behind the step that could actually make it happen.
cards.details: Neptune in Aries sextile Pluto in Aquarius. A cause people believe in meets a group already asking who the current arrangement serves. Neptune in Aries supplies an ideal worth starting now, and Pluto in Aquarius supplies the pressure that exposes who holds power inside a system. Because this is a sextile the opening is offered rather than automatic, and an urgent push meeting a structure built to hold means the workable move is the one that fits what the system will not give up.

cards.forecast: new information may make a plan that seemed out of reach feel suddenly possible. Uranus in Gemini sextile Neptune in Aries can open a route forward while the facts are still changing. Encouraging news is not the same as confirmation. Follow the opening, but check the details before you build the whole plan around it.
cards.details: Uranus in Gemini sextile Neptune in Aries. New information lands and a hoped-for plan suddenly looks reachable. Uranus in Gemini keeps rewriting the available routes as the facts change, while Neptune in Aries supplies the belief that makes starting feel clearer than the evidence warrants. A sextile offers the connection without forcing it, and since the facts are still moving while the appetite to begin is not, a decision holds only if it names the day it gets checked again.

cards.forecast: a better way of doing things may be right in front of you, but you still need to know what problem you’re solving. Uranus in Gemini trine Pluto in Aquarius can bring the insight, information, or strategy that helps you change how the work gets done. Don’t overhaul the plan just because a new option looks more interesting. Get clear on what is actually holding things back, then make the change that solves that problem.
cards.details: Uranus in Gemini trine Pluto in Aquarius. A newer explanation lines up with a longer push to change who the rules favor. Uranus in Gemini changes the terms as information lands; Pluto in Aquarius concentrates on the power a system keeps distributing. Trines meet little resistance, and because the language can be rewritten while the underlying requirement cannot, the requirement has to be said out loud before the rewrites amount to anything.

cards.forecast: something you’ve been working toward may finally have enough support to become possible. Jupiter in Leo trine Saturn in Aries can bring growth and structure together: more backing, confidence, or opportunity, plus a limit that helps you decide what can actually be done. The temptation is to make the plan bigger just because things are going well. Take the opportunity, but keep the scope small enough to follow through.
cards.details: Jupiter in Leo trine Saturn in Aries. Visible support and a firm deadline arrive together. Jupiter in Leo enlarges what generous backing can do for somebody's contribution, and Saturn in Aries supplies the deadline that decides how much of it can actually be built. The trine lets both work toward the same result, though fire on both sides can make speed feel like proof, so the scope has to fit the schedule rather than the enthusiasm.

cards.forecast: a deadline may create the opening to change something everyone already knows is not working. Saturn in Aries sextile Pluto in Aquarius can make it easier to deal with a rule, structure, or arrangement that has been hard to move. The opportunity can disappear if everyone waits for someone else to raise the problem. Put it on the table while there is still time to change it.
cards.details: Saturn in Aries sextile Pluto in Aquarius. A firm deadline gives a group the occasion to ask who the current arrangement actually serves. Saturn in Aries sets how fast a first move is allowed to go, while Pluto in Aquarius works on who holds power inside a system many people share. A sextile offers that combination rather than forcing it, and since a date forces movement while the arrangement is built not to give, the pressure gathers on the arrangement rather than on who argues hardest.

cards.forecast: doing something well can quickly lead to more visibility, responsibility, or influence. Mars conjunct Jupiter in Leo can make one strong effort turn into a much bigger opportunity. That may be worth saying yes to, but more recognition does not automatically mean you have room to take on everything that comes with it. Before you commit, get clear on what you are actually agreeing to.
cards.details: Mars in Leo conjunct Jupiter in Leo. One person's push and one person's growing role arrive as a single event. Mars in Leo puts effort where it will be seen and named, and Jupiter in Leo enlarges what that visibility can be turned into. A conjunction fuses the two, so any move on one is a move on the other, and with both in a fixed fire sign the appetite grows faster than anyone stops to check it.

cards.forecast: you may have to commit before all the information is in. Saturn in Aries sextile Uranus in Gemini supports a plan that is firm enough to act on and flexible enough to change when the facts do. Waiting for certainty can become its own way of losing time. Make the best decision available now, and decide what new information would justify changing course.
cards.details: Saturn in Aries sextile Uranus in Gemini. A deadline and a stream of revised information land on the same plan. Saturn in Aries sets what a rushed start has to prove before it counts, while Uranus in Gemini keeps rewriting the options as new facts arrive. The sextile connects them without forcing the issue, and since a decision is being pressed while conditions underneath it will not hold still, what survives is a decision that carries its own review point.

cards.forecast: a clear deadline can give you exactly the structure you need to get something finished. Mars in Leo trine Saturn in Aries can focus your effort once the responsibility is clear and the end point is defined. Progress may come quickly, which makes it tempting to add more while things are going well. Use the momentum to finish what you started, not make the plan bigger.
cards.details: Mars in Leo trine Saturn in Aries. Visible ownership of an effort meets a limit that gives it a shape. Mars in Leo spends energy where the result will carry somebody's name, and Saturn in Aries attaches a deadline that limits how much of it can be maintained. The trine lets both pull the same way, so the assumption nobody checks is the size of the thing, and with fire on both sides speed keeps being read as evidence the scope was right.

cards.forecast: a request for more openness can turn into a fight about privacy and control. Venus in Scorpio square Pluto in Aquarius can expose a deeper disagreement about what has to be shared, who gets access, and who gets to decide. More careful wording will not solve a conflict about where the boundary actually is. Be specific about what stays private, what needs to be shared, and who gets a say.
cards.details: Venus in Scorpio square Pluto in Aquarius. A request for closer access collides with a group changing who controls the outcome. Venus in Scorpio treats access to what somebody keeps hidden as the thing being negotiated, while Pluto in Aquarius moves control across a system rather than between two people. A square does not let either requirement stand down, so with both sides dug in the arrangement itself is what has to give.

cards.forecast: a boost for one person can change how a partnership works. Venus in Libra sextile Jupiter in Leo can bring more visibility, support, money, or opportunity to one person, which may shift what each side is contributing. If one role gets bigger, the split may need to change too. Talk about it while the news is still good, and make sure the setup still works for everyone involved.
cards.details: Venus in Libra sextile Jupiter in Leo. Open backing for one contribution meets a running check on whether the exchange is mutual. Venus in Libra measures an agreement by whether both sides are getting something comparable, and Jupiter in Leo gives generously enough to make one contribution stand out. A sextile makes the pair workable without obliging anyone to act, and because an immediate push is meeting a position that will not be given up, the terms carry the strain rather than the generosity.

cards.forecast: a deadline can help you stop researching and start deciding. Mercury in Gemini sextile Saturn in Aries can help you choose a workable direction even while some of the details are still changing. More information may improve the decision, but it can also keep you circling the options past the point when a choice is useful. Pick the best path with what you know now, then set a review point for anything that genuinely changes the picture.
cards.details: Mercury in Gemini sextile Saturn in Aries. An open question and a fixed date arrive at the same decision. Mercury in Gemini keeps another comparison alive so the answer stays provisional, while Saturn in Aries sets the point at which staying provisional stops being useful. The sextile connects them without forcing the issue, and because changing conditions are being pushed toward a decision, what survives is a decision that names its own review.

cards.forecast: once you put your work where other people can respond to it, you also have to decide which criticism deserves to change it. The Sun in Leo sextile Mars in Libra can help you defend what matters about your contribution while still hearing an objection that improves the result. Diplomacy does not mean making every criticism equally important, and confidence does not mean refusing to adjust. Know what you are trying to protect before the conversation starts. Then you can change what strengthens the work without negotiating away the part that made it yours.
cards.details: Sun in Leo sextile Mars in Libra. Work shown openly meets an objection stated without a fight. The Sun in Leo puts weight on keeping a contribution attached to the person who made it, and Mars in Libra spends its energy measuring fairness before it spends any on conflict. A sextile offers the combination rather than producing it, and because a held position is being pressed for action, the movement has to happen inside what neither side is willing to drop.

cards.forecast: an idea can start attracting support before you’ve had time to decide what you’re actually promising. Mercury in Gemini sextile Jupiter in Leo can make it easier to share possibilities, get people interested, and see how much further an idea could go. That enthusiasm can be useful because other people may see potential you had not considered yet, but attention can also make an unfinished idea feel more certain than it is. Let the response expand your thinking without letting it make the decision for you. Be clear about what you’re excited about, what you’ve committed to, and what is still allowed to change.
cards.details: Mercury in Gemini sextile Jupiter in Leo. Several live versions of a plan meet public backing for one of them. Mercury in Gemini keeps more than one answer available, while Jupiter in Leo lends enough confidence to make a single version look larger than it is. The sextile makes that pairing usable, and since the flexible side keeps reshaping itself around a requirement nobody has stated, that requirement has to be said plainly before any of the reshaping counts.

cards.forecast: you can fix the problem without turning someone into the problem. The Sun in Virgo sextile Mars in Cancer can make it easier to notice what went wrong, take care of the immediate consequences, and protect the person involved from unnecessary blame. But protecting someone is different from protecting the pattern that caused the mistake. Handle what needs fixing first. Then have the conversation that makes it safer, clearer, or easier to do differently next time.
cards.details: Sun in Virgo sextile Mars in Cancer. A correction and an act of cover arrive on the same problem. The Sun in Virgo attaches standing to whoever gets the detail right, and Mars in Cancer spends its energy protecting a person before it explains itself. The sextile makes the two usable together, and because a practical limit and a human stake are inside one decision, the arrangement has to answer both rather than letting the fix speak for the loyalty.

cards.forecast: someone stepping up can change the balance of a connection faster than either person realizes. Venus in Libra sextile Mars in Leo can make one person’s effort, initiative, or visibility more obvious, which may also expose responsibilities that were never clearly divided in the first place. Appreciation matters, but praise does not redistribute the work. Talk about what each person is actually carrying while there is still goodwill to work with.
cards.details: Venus in Libra sextile Mars in Leo. A public commitment meets a running question about whether the exchange is mutual. Venus in Libra reads an agreement by what each side is actually giving, while Mars in Leo pushes hardest when the result will carry a name. A sextile makes the two workable rather than automatic, and because an immediate push is meeting a position built to hold, the terms are where the strain shows up.

cards.forecast: a plan can sound convincing until it meets the promise people are already counting on. Mercury in Aquarius opposite Jupiter in Leo can expose the gap between what makes sense in theory and what has already been offered, announced, or expected. Neither side becomes irrelevant just because the other has a strong argument. Before defending the plan or the promise, compare both with the time, money, and capacity actually available.
cards.details: Mercury in Aquarius opposite Jupiter in Leo. A system-changing idea and a public promise are visible at the same time. Mercury in Aquarius weighs a change by what it would do to everybody covered by it, while Jupiter in Leo has already extended more than the work behind it will support. An opposition holds the two side by side so neither gets quietly dropped, and since neither position is expendable, the terms get rewritten before anybody backs down.

cards.forecast: being praised for what you did is not always the same as feeling valued for who you are. The Sun conjunct Venus in Leo can bring recognition, affection, and visibility together, which can make it easy to assume one kind of appreciation should cover all three. If someone still feels overlooked after receiving credit, they may be asking for a different kind of acknowledgment. Name what they contributed, then make the appreciation personal.
cards.details: Sun in Leo conjunct Venus in Leo. Recognition for work and appreciation for a person land in one event. The Sun in Leo puts weight on effort being acknowledged as somebody's own, and Venus in Leo needs the liking to be visible to somebody besides the two people involved. A conjunction runs them through one event, so satisfying either request is also a decision about the other, and with both fixed and in fire the unmet one gets louder rather than quieter.

cards.forecast: when the stakes are high, rewriting the message can feel easier than naming the power struggle underneath it. Mercury in Scorpio square Pluto in Aquarius can make every word feel consequential when the larger question is who gets to decide what happens next. Better wording may make the conversation more careful, but it will not resolve a disagreement about control. Stop editing around the point. Say what needs to be decided, who has the authority to decide it, and what you need from them.
cards.details: Mercury in Scorpio square Pluto in Aquarius. Carefully chosen words meet a change in who controls the outcome. Mercury in Scorpio makes the exact phrasing consequential because it cannot be withdrawn once sent, and Pluto in Aquarius moves the decision out of individual hands and into the structure everybody is subject to. In a square neither requirement can be quietly dropped, so the wording improves while the demand underneath it stays put.

cards.forecast: people may start treating an unconfirmed possibility like a done deal. Mercury in Scorpio square Jupiter in Leo can create tension between what is known privately and what is being said publicly. Wanting something to happen can make people talk about it like it already will. Protect what needs to stay private, but be clear about what is confirmed and what is still uncertain.
cards.details: Mercury in Scorpio square Jupiter in Leo. Guarded information meets a promise already extended in public. Mercury in Scorpio holds back until the phrasing is exact, because what gets said cannot be unsaid, while Jupiter in Leo commits to more than the work supports once the response is encouraging. The square refuses to let either requirement be quietly set aside, so the gap reappears in every attempt to close it, and pushing something guarded into public view raises the volume and not the safety.

cards.forecast: a difficult conversation can go off track when being respected starts to matter more than getting the issue resolved. Mercury in Scorpio square Mars in Leo can make one person push for an answer while the other becomes more careful about what they are willing to say. The harder the pressure gets, the easier it is to start defending yourself instead of dealing with the decision in front of you. Don’t let the fight about tone become the whole conversation. Say what you know, be clear about what still needs time, and come back to the problem you were trying to solve.
cards.details: Mercury in Scorpio square Mars in Leo. Deliberate wording meets an effort that has somebody's pride attached to it. Mercury in Scorpio chooses its words slowly because the result cannot be undone, and Mars in Leo pushes harder once recognition is part of what is at stake. The square leaves neither requirement anywhere to go, so every reply restates the same problem in a sharper tone while the decision itself does not move.

cards.forecast: new information can show you a better way to get where you’re going. Mars in Leo sextile Uranus in Gemini can help you adjust quickly without losing sight of what you set out to accomplish. Commitment to the outcome does not require loyalty to an outdated method. If the plan stops making sense, change the plan. Keep the promise that matters and let the strategy evolve as you learn more.
cards.details: Mars in Leo sextile Uranus in Gemini. Visible commitment meets information that rewrites the route. Mars in Leo carries an effort through where people can watch it, while Uranus in Gemini alters the available options almost as fast as the facts arrive. A sextile offers the pairing without compelling it, and since one side will not bend while the other keeps adapting, the part that is not up for negotiation has to be stated instead of worked around.

cards.forecast: a hard conversation can actually move things forward when it gives you something concrete to fix. Venus in Scorpio sextile Mars in Virgo supports the kind of honesty that names what hurt and then does something about it. Reassurance helps, but follow-through is what rebuilds trust. Make the repair, keep the promise, and let your actions show that you were listening.
cards.details: Venus in Scorpio sextile Mars in Virgo. A private disclosure meets effort aimed at the fault that can actually be repaired. Venus in Scorpio raises what a connection is worth once each side knows exactly what is at risk in it, and Mars in Virgo spends its energy on the specific thing that is not working. A sextile makes the two usable together without guaranteeing it, and since something that matters personally has to fit inside what is materially possible, the shape of the fix may move as long as the reason for it is not dismissed.

cards.forecast: you do not have to choose between giving people more freedom and keeping enough structure for things to work. Mercury in Aquarius sextile Venus in Sagittarius can help you find an approach that gives people more room without losing the standards, responsibilities, or expectations everyone still needs to share. Individual freedom and collective structure do not automatically have to compete. Build enough structure to keep things working, then give people room to make the rest their own.
cards.details: Mercury in Aquarius sextile Venus in Sagittarius. A proposed rule meets a preference for arrangements that leave people space to grow. Mercury in Aquarius shows where a new rule would hold up across the group, and Venus in Sagittarius chooses the agreement that does not close off an independent plan. The sextile makes the pair workable without making it automatic, and since one requirement will not bend while the surrounding conditions keep shifting, a demonstration carries what an argument could not.

cards.forecast: a disagreement can finally move once people say who the current arrangement is actually working for. Mars in Libra trine Pluto in Aquarius can make it easier to challenge a rule or set of terms without ending the negotiation. The risk is everyone agreeing on the wording while still having a different idea of what is actually going to change. Put the change in concrete terms before anyone calls the matter settled.
cards.details: Mars in Libra trine Pluto in Aquarius. A disagreement stated carefully meets a group pressing on who the arrangement serves. Mars in Libra puts the objection into words that do not blow up the plan it belongs to, while Pluto in Aquarius keeps asking who benefits from the way power is currently held. A trine meets little resistance, and since nothing here has to leave the level of wording, people can agree on a phrase well before they agree on what it names.
